title: VectorLayer native evaluated VectorArt handoff

observed_result: Both versions have direct CALLs to Group constructor, TDB_StreamID, TDB_StreamIDPath, PopulateVectorArt, GetBounds; path returns intrusive VectorArt group.
limitations: Offline CALL references do not prove native third-party custom type registration
